FREELANCE DESIGN AGREEMENT

This Freelance Design Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on February 9, 2026 between Linden Street Bakery LLC ("Client") and the designer named on the signature page ("Designer").

Section 1 - The Project

1.1 Designer will create a new logo, a one-page brand style guide and a set of six social media templates for Client (the "Deliverables").
1.2 Designer will present three initial logo concepts by March 2, 2026 and deliver the final files by March 30, 2026.
1.3 Client will give Designer its existing menu, photographs and any brand notes within five business days of signing.
1.4 The fee includes two rounds of revisions on the chosen logo concept and one round on the templates.
1.5 Designer decides how, when and where to do the work, and is an independent contractor, not an employee of Client.

Section 2 - Fees and Payment

2.1 Client will pay Designer a fixed fee of $3,200 for the Deliverables.
2.2 Client will pay half of the fee on signing and the other half on delivery of the final files.
2.3 Designer will invoice by email, and Client will pay each invoice within 15 days of receiving it.
2.4 Additional work that Client requests beyond the revisions in Section 1 is billed at $70 per hour, but only after Client approves an estimate in writing.

Section 3 - Ownership

3.1 Once Client has paid the full fee, Designer assigns to Client the copyright in the final Deliverables.
3.2 Designer keeps ownership of the unused concepts, sketches and drafts, and of the fonts, software, templates, techniques and other tools that Designer owned or developed before or apart from this project.
3.3 Where a final Deliverable includes any of Designer's pre-existing tools, Designer grants Client a permanent, non-exclusive license to use them as part of that Deliverable.
3.4 Designer may show the final Deliverables in Designer's portfolio after Client has publicly launched them.

Section 4 - Confidentiality

4.1 Each party will keep confidential any non-public business information the other shares for this project and use it only for this project.
4.2 This obligation does not cover information that is public, already known to the receiving party, or lawfully received from someone else.
4.3 The confidentiality obligations in this Section 4 last for one year after the project ends.

Section 5 - Term and Termination

5.1 This Agreement starts when both parties sign it and ends when Client has paid for the final Deliverables, unless it is terminated earlier under this Section 5.
5.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason by giving the other party 14 days' written notice.
5.3 If either party terminates, Client will pay Designer for all work completed up to the termination date, at the hourly rate in Section 2, and the deposit counts toward that amount.
5.4 On termination, Designer will deliver all work completed and paid for up to that date.
5.5 This Agreement does not renew automatically, and any further work requires a new written agreement.

Section 6 - Other Work

6.1 Designer is free to work for other clients, including other food businesses, during and after this project.

Section 7 - Responsibility and Liability

7.1 Designer confirms that the final Deliverables will be Designer's original work, except for materials Client supplies.
7.2 Client confirms that it has the right to use the materials it gives Designer for the project.
7.3 Each party will indemnify the other against third-party claims caused by its own breach of the confirmations in this Section 7.
7.4 Each party's total liability to the other under this Agreement is limited to the total fee payable under this Agreement, except for unpaid fees owed to Designer.
7.5 Neither party is liable to the other for indirect or consequential losses arising from this Agreement.

Section 8 - Disputes

8.1 The parties will first try to settle any dispute arising under this Agreement through a good-faith conversation between them.
8.2 If a dispute arising under this Agreement is not settled within 30 days, either party may bring it in the small claims or state courts of the county where Client's bakery is located.

Section 9 - General Terms

9.1 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties about the project and can be changed only in a writing signed by both parties.
9.2 Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent by email to the addresses on the signature page.
9.3 If any part of this Agreement is found unenforceable, the rest stays in effect.
